Bitmask Immediate Decoding (DecodeBitMasks)

def decodeBitMasksLevelsL41–52 ↗#

Compute the levels bitmask (esize - 1, i.e. 1, 3, 7, 15, 31, or 63) from (immN, imms) by finding the highest clear bit of immN : ~~~imms. Corresponds to HighestSetBit(immN:NOT(imms)) in ARM's DecodeBitMasks pseudocode: returns 0 when len < 1 (i.e. immN = 0 and imms = 0b11111x, which is UNDEFINED).

def decodeBitMasksLevels (immN : Bool) (imms : BitVec 6) : BitVec 6 := if immN then 63#6 else if !(imms.getLsbD 5) then 31#6 else if !(imms.getLsbD 4) then 15#6 else if !(imms.getLsbD 3) then 7#6 else if !(imms.getLsbD 2) then 3#6 else if !(imms.getLsbD 1) then 1#6 else 0#6

def decodeBitMasksValidL54–62 ↗#

Validity predicate for (immN, imms, immr) in A64 logical-immediate instructions:

  1. levels != 0 (len >= 1 in HighestSetBit(immN:NOT(imms)));

  2. S != levels (the all-ones element S = esize - 1 is reserved);

  3. (immr &&& ~~~levels) == 0 (canonical rotation immr < esize, so each encodable 64-bit bitmask has a unique (immN, imms, immr) representation).

def decodeBitMasksValid (immN : Bool) (imms immr : BitVec 6) : Bool := let levels := decodeBitMasksLevels immN imms let s := imms &&& levels s != levels && (immr &&& ~~~levels) == 0#6

def decodeBitMasksValL64–88 ↗#

Mask construction half of ARM's DecodeBitMasks, assuming decodeBitMasksValid.

Builds S + 1 consecutive ones inside an esize-bit element (esize = levels + 1), rotates that element right by R, and then replicates it across all 64 bits by the usual doubling chain (2 -> 4 -> 8 -> 16 -> 32 -> 64). The result is the WMask of the ARM pseudocode; TMask is not needed because A64 logical immediates only use WMask.

The value returned for an invalid (immN, imms, immr) is unspecified; callers should go through decodeBitMasks.

def decodeBitMasksVal (immN : Bool) (imms immr : BitVec 6) : BitVec 64 := let levels := decodeBitMasksLevels immN imms let s : BitVec 6 := imms &&& levels let r : BitVec 6 := immr &&& levels let elemOnes : BitVec 64 := (2#64 <<< s.zeroExtend 64) - 1#64 let elemMask : BitVec 64 := (2#64 <<< levels.zeroExtend 64) - 1#64 let elemRotated : BitVec 64 := if r == 0#6 then elemOnes else let shlAmt : BitVec 6 := (levels - r) + 1#6 ((elemOnes >>> r.zeroExtend 64) ||| (elemOnes <<< shlAmt.zeroExtend 64)) &&& elemMask let r2 := if levels.ule 1#6 then elemRotated ||| (elemRotated <<< 2#64) else elemRotated let r4 := if levels.ule 3#6 then r2 ||| (r2 <<< 4#64) else r2 let r8 := if levels.ule 7#6 then r4 ||| (r4 <<< 8#64) else r4 let r16 := if levels.ule 15#6 then r8 ||| (r8 <<< 16#64) else r8 if levels.ule 31#6 then r16 ||| (r16 <<< 32#64) else r16

def decodeBitMasksL90–97 ↗#

ARM's DecodeBitMasks as a partial function: decode a logical-immediate encoding (N, imms, immr) into the 64-bit replicated bitmask it denotes, or none if the encoding is UNDEFINED. Inverse of Arm64.encodeBitMasks.

def decodeBitMasks (immN : Bool) (imms immr : BitVec 6) : Option (BitVec 64) := if decodeBitMasksValid immN imms immr then some (decodeBitMasksVal immN imms immr) else none

Load/Store Sub-Decoders

def mkLoadStoreInstL103–120 ↗#

Construct a general-purpose single-register load/store Instr (Instr.ldr or Instr.str) from sizeBits (bits[31:30]), opc (bits[23:22]), target register rt, and addr : AddrMode.

def mkLoadStoreInst (sizeBits opc : Nat) (rt : Reg) (addr : AddrMode) : Option Instr := match sizeBits, opc with | 0, 0 => some (.str .B8 rt addr) | 0, 1 => some (.ldr .W32 .B8 false rt addr) | 0, 2 => some (.ldr .W64 .B8 true rt addr) | 0, 3 => some (.ldr .W32 .B8 true rt addr) | 1, 0 => some (.str .H16 rt addr) | 1, 1 => some (.ldr .W32 .H16 false rt addr) | 1, 2 => some (.ldr .W64 .H16 true rt addr) | 1, 3 => some (.ldr .W32 .H16 true rt addr) | 2, 0 => some (.str .W32 rt addr) | 2, 1 => some (.ldr .W32 .W32 false rt addr) | 2, 2 => some (.ldr .W64 .W32 true rt addr) | 3, 0 => some (.str .X64 rt addr) | 3, 1 => some (.ldr .W64 .X64 false rt addr) | _, _ => none

def decodeSimdLoadStoreTypeL122–135 ↗#

Decode (sizeBits, opc) for a SIMD/FP single-register load/store into (isLoad, sz, scale).

def decodeSimdLoadStoreType (sizeBits opc : Nat) : Option (Bool × SimdMemSize × Nat) := match sizeBits, opc with | 0, 0 => some (false, .B8, 0) | 0, 1 => some (true, .B8, 0) | 0, 2 => some (false, .Q128, 4) | 0, 3 => some (true, .Q128, 4) | 1, 0 => some (false, .H16, 1) | 1, 1 => some (true, .H16, 1) | 2, 0 => some (false, .S32, 2) | 2, 1 => some (true, .S32, 2) | 3, 0 => some (false, .D64, 3) | 3, 1 => some (true, .D64, 3) | _, _ => none
